name: Local Business Digital Launch
description: Complete digital presence setup for a new or existing local business — website, GMB, social, SEO, and lead gen

parameters.label: Service Area
parameters.placeholder: e.g. Pittsburgh, PA and surrounding areas

parameters.label: Main Services Offered
parameters.placeholder: e.g. roof repairs, new roofs, gutter installation

parameters.label: Existing Assets
parameters.placeholder: e.g. has logo, has website, has Facebook page, starting from scratch

steps.task: Research the local market for {{business_name}} ({{industry}}) serving {{location}}. Identify: top local competitors, what they do well/poorly online, customer review patterns, pricing signals, dominant platforms, and the most effective lead gen channels for {{industry}} in this area. Existing assets: {{existing_assets}}.

Design the complete digital presence strategy for {{business_name}}. Services: {{services}}. Area: {{location}}. Budget: {{budget}}. Create: website sitemap and page structure, GMB optimization checklist, social media platform selection and setup guide, review generation strategy, and the customer acquisition funnel from awareness to booked job.

Create the brand and content foundation for {{business_name}} ({{industry}}). Produce: brand voice guide, visual style recommendations, website copy for home page and key service pages ({{services}}), Google Business Profile description, social media bio copy, and 5 content pillars with sample posts. Tone should match {{industry}} in {{location}}.

Build the digital launch checklist for {{business_name}}. Create a step-by-step setup guide for: website deployment (with recommended tech stack given {{existing_assets}}), Google Business Profile setup/optimization, Facebook/Instagram business profiles, Nextdoor business account, review request templates (email + text), and contact form/lead capture setup. Make it so an admin with no tech background can follow it.

Create the first 90-day growth plan for {{business_name}}. Budget: {{budget}}. Include: week-by-week action items, organic content schedule, paid ad strategy (Google Local Services or Facebook if budget allows), referral program idea, local partnership outreach targets, and review generation campaign. Prioritize highest-ROI actions for a {{industry}} business in {{location}}.

Compile the Digital Launch Package report for {{business_name}}. Format as a client-ready deliverable covering: what we're launching, why each piece matters, the 90-day roadmap, expected outcomes at 30/60/90 days, and a monthly reporting dashboard they can use to track progress (leads, calls, reviews, rankings).
